_doc: Real DPMP vehicle (register type + paint) -> custom Czech pak128 object. Object name = VZ-DPPardubice-<token>-<livery>-<core> (the pak's own scheme, see assets/pak_installed.json, read from the pak checkout by 00_pak_objects.py). 'types' gives the token, the core, the real length in metres and the car units of the object (16 = one tile). The livery comes from the first matching paint rule; a full advert wrap (CVR) or a side sticker (bokolep) keeps the type's normal livery (user rule, 29 Sep: an advert maps to the type's normal livery unless the pak gives it its own object). An object missing from pak_installed.json is shown as 'requested' (never a stand-in from another city). All objects are waytype=road; the trolleybus objects are engine_type=electric and need no wire in the game, so battery sections are information only.

Škoda 28 Tr.note: Three axles, Solaris Urbino 15 body; the only trolleybuses longer than 12 m (406 and 409).

Škoda 32 Tr.note: The object is the 32 Tr in DPMP's black-front white-black-red scheme, which every 32 Tr from 2023 on wears; the 2019 cars (425–429) are advert wraps.

paint_rules: full advert wrap: the type's normal livery
plain white, a real livery of its own (no DPMP stripes)
plain white with a side sticker: the white base
white with red stripes: the DPMP scheme
the DPMP scheme (red stripes on white; red-and-silver stripe on the newest buses; black front on the 32 Tr)

battery_cars.source: Old Pardubice sheet (26 Sep 2026, from trolejbus.cz 18 Mar 2026 and seznam-autobusu.cz): traction-battery ('AKU') trolleybuses are the 30 Tr 480–483 (2018) and the 32 Tr 460–469 and 476–497 (2023–2025). 425–429 (32 Tr, 2019) and the other 26 Tr / 28 Tr / 30 Tr have no traction battery.
